question: Which of the following parts of an email is used to indicate the details of the sender and recipient, as well as the date and time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Email header**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **email header** is used to indicate the details of the sender and recipient, as well as the date and time.
 
• It is a crucial part of an email that helps in identifying the source and destination of the message.
 
• Other parts of an email, such as the subject line and body, serve different purposes.
 
• The header information is typically hidden by default in most email clients but can be viewed by the user if needed.
 
• Understanding email headers can be useful for troubleshooting email delivery issues and verifying the authenticity of the message.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An email header typically includes fields like **From**, **To**, **Date**, **Subject**, and **Message-ID**.
 
• The **From** field indicates the sender's email address.
 
• The **To** field shows the recipient's email address.
 
• The **Date** field shows the date and time when the email was sent.
 
• The **Message-ID** is a unique identifier for the email message.
 
• Some email headers may also include additional information such as **Received** paths, **Reply-To** addresses, and **Return-Path** information.
 
• Analyzing email headers can help in identifying spam or phishing emails by tracing the path the email took from the sender to the recipient.
